title: Build an Elixir Phoenix LiveView Native SwiftUI format screen with disconnect recovery and native iOS navigation

contextSnapshot.surface: iOS real-time warehouse pick-list screen powered by Phoenix LiveView Native
contextSnapshot.platform: Elixir / Phoenix LiveView Native (SwiftUI client format)
constraints: idiomatic SwiftUI format templates (.swiftui.heex) rather than HTML tags

prompt: Implement a warehouse pick-list screen in our Elixir Phoenix LiveView Native app targeting iOS SwiftUI (.swiftui.heex), handling live item-claim updates, temporary WebSocket disconnects in warehouse dead zones, and Dynamic Type legibility.
forbiddenBehaviors: renders HTML <div>/<table> markup inside a LiveView Native SwiftUI template instead of native SwiftUI elements (<List>, <VStack>, <Button>)
assumes continuous WebSocket connectivity without an explicit offline/reconnecting banner and pending-action guard
triggers server round-trips on every text-field keystroke without phx-debounce or local buffering
claims Xcode Simulator rendering passed from mix test alone

rubricDimensions.pass: uses clean .swiftui.heex templates with native SwiftUI views/modifiers, Dynamic Type text styles, and shared Elixir LiveView state without leaking HTML idioms
rubricDimensions.fail: copies web HEEx HTML tags or hardcodes pixel frame sizes

rubricDimensions.pass: exposes clear reconnecting/stale-data feedback in dead zones, disables conflicting mutations during disconnect, debounces search/scan input, and maintains >= 44pt targets
rubricDimensions.fail: silently drops taps while disconnected or spams server events per keystroke

rubricDimensions.pass: distinguishes mix test LiveView state tests from rendered Xcode Simulator / iOS device checks
rubricDimensions.fail: equates Elixir unit tests with rendered iOS SwiftUI verification

negativeControls.name: mix test pass only
negativeControls.input: mix test passes all LiveView controller assertions
negativeControls.mustNot: claim iOS SwiftUI layout, VoiceOver focus, or Dynamic Type scaling is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: leaks HTML/Tailwind markup into LiveView Native templates, ignores dead-zone reconnect states, and omits Dynamic Type and VoiceOver considerations
baseline.withSkill: builds idiomatic Phoenix LiveView Native SwiftUI templates with disconnect resilience, debounced events, native accessibility, and explicit evidence labels
